description: This file implements the BluetoothChatService class, which manages establishing, maintaining, and handling data transfer over Bluetooth connections in an Android application, including server socket listening, client connection, and data transmission threads.

classes.name: BluetoothChatService
classes.description: Manages Bluetooth connection lifecycle, handling server and client sockets, connection states, and data transfer threads.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the current connection state and notifies the handler.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts listening for incoming Bluetooth connections by initiating AcceptThread(s).

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Attempts to connect to a remote Bluetooth device, starting a ConnectThread.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Handles a successful connection, starting the ConnectedThread to manage data transfer.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all ongoing threads related to Bluetooth connection and resets state.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Sends data through the active Bluetooth connection.

methods.name: connectionFailed
methods.description: Handles a failed connection attempt, notifies UI, and restarts listening.

methods.name: connectionLost
methods.description: Handles loss of an established connection, notifies UI, and restarts listening.
